Prisoner Escapes from Kurukshetra Hospital Ward

A prisoner escaped from the LNJP hospital's ward in Kurukshetra. The prisoner had been apprehended four days prior and had reportedly attempted suicide in jail. The escape occurred while the prisoner was taken out to drink water with a security guard. The incident was captured on CCTV footage.
